Rajasthan Local Body Elections: Reservation Lottery to Decide Seats

In Rajasthan, a reservation lottery is being conducted today for 309 local bodies. This process will determine the political equations for the upcoming local body elections. The lottery, based on a rotation policy, is expected to significantly alter the prospects of aspiring candidates. The outcome will decide which wards are reserved for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes, impacting the electoral landscape.
